decisions.question: How are items ranked in the 'Next Up' surface?
options: Hybrid — user-pinned items first, then algorithmic suggestions
Pure algorithmic — system decides, user can dismiss
Pure manual — only items the user explicitly pinned
decisions.selected: Hybrid — user-pinned items first, then algorithmic suggestions

decisions.question: Where does the 'Next Up' surface live in the app?
options: Dashboard widget at the top of the home page
Slide-out drawer triggered from the global nav
decisions.selected: Dashboard widget at the top of the home page

decisions.question: What does each 'Next Up' item look like?
options: Card with cover art, progress bar, and dismiss button
Compact list row with title + media-type icon
Full-bleed hero card, one item at a time
decisions.selected: Card with cover art, progress bar, and dismiss button

decisions.question: What shows when the backlog is empty?
options: Friendly empty-state with a 'Browse library' CTA
Show last-completed item with a 'finished it?' prompt
decisions.selected: Friendly empty-state with a 'Browse library' CTA

decisions.question: Where do we compute ranking scores?
options: Server-side, nightly cron — cache results, client reads pre-computed scores
decisions.selected: Server-side, nightly cron — cache results, client reads pre-computed scores

decisions.question: How do we store the ranking signals (recency, progress, series continuity)?
options: Denormalized columns on the library_item table
Separate ranking_signals table, joined at scoring time
